surface: sidebar-schema (SchemaTree, DbSwitcher, SavedQueries, schema/saved stores, introspect.rs)
works: Single round-trip 5-statement introspection (tables+cols+pk, FKs, functions, schemas, indexes) as json_agg cells; refreshed on connect, ⌘R, DDL-sniff, and palette
Fuzzy subsequence filter with ⌘⇧F focus shortcut; per-schema grouping with counts, expand/collapse, filter auto-expands undecided schemas
Click=browse (dedupes into existing table tab), double-click=SELECT-in-new-tab+run; right-click menu: Browse / Open SELECT / Copy name / Copy qualified / Copy SELECT / Refresh
View+matview get distinct Eye icon; hover tooltip shows column count + pk
DbSwitcher lists live pg_database via a guaranteed-live session, reuses an existing sibling profile or clones one, checkmarks current db

Saved queries persist in appdb; open dedupes to the linked tab; inline rename syncs open tab names; Duplicate/Copy SQL/Delete (DangerModal via menu, 2-click arm via hover trash); ⌘S bookmarks the active tab; collapsible section with count + empty-state hint
Schema snapshots keyed per profile; fetch failure keeps the previous snapshot instead of clobbering; loading flag per profile
ContextMenu primitive is keyboard-navigable (arrows/Enter/Esc), clamped, supports submenus

gaps.title: Generated SQL uses unquoted identifiers — breaks or silently queries the wrong table
gaps.detail: SchemaTree.tsx:53-70 builds `SELECT * FROM ${ref}` and Copy SELECT/Copy qualified name with raw names. A mixed-case table ("Users"), reserved word ("order"), or name with spaces/unicode errors out — or worse, PG case-folds and reads a DIFFERENT lowercase table with the same folded name (violates 'never lies'). browser.ts:92 already has qi(); extract it to a shared util and quote-when-needed (regex ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_$]*$ + reserved-word list) in insertSelect, tableMenu, and Copy qualified name.

gaps.title: Double-click on a table fires single-click too — opens BOTH a browse tab and a query tab
gaps.detail: SchemaTree.tsx:113-114: onClick (browse) fires twice before onDoubleClick (insertSelect+run) on every double-click, so the user gets a table tab AND a new query tab that immediately runs. Fix: disambiguate with a ~200ms single-click delay, or make double-click cancel the pending browse (store timeout id, clearTimeout in onDoubleClick).

gaps.title: Introspection failure silently blanks the sidebar — no error, no retry
gaps.detail: schema.ts:72-74 only console.errors; SchemaTree.tsx:43 returns null when no snapshot. If connect succeeds but introspect fails (statement_timeout, permissions, giant catalog), the user stares at an empty sidebar forever. Render an error row with the message + a Retry button; keep the filter input visible.

gaps.title: Every refresh blanks the whole tree to 'Loading schema…'
gaps.detail: SchemaTree.tsx:42 returns early on loading, so ⌘R and every DDL-sniff refetch unmounts the tree + filter input, losing scroll position and visual context for seconds on big catalogs. Stale-while-revalidate: keep rendering the old snapshot with a small spinner in the header; only show the loading message when there is no snapshot yet.

gaps.title: No keyboard navigation from filter into tree — ⌘⇧F is a dead end
gaps.detail: SchemaTree.tsx:86-92: after focusing the filter you must grab the mouse. Table-stakes in every mature client: ArrowDown/Up moves a selection through visible rows, Enter browses, ⌘Enter/Shift-Enter opens SELECT in editor, Esc clears filter then blurs, Left/Right collapses/expands schema headers. Roving selection index + scrollIntoView; this is the single biggest 'keyboard-first' violation on this surface.

gaps.title: Tree is not virtualized; every filter keystroke re-renders every row
gaps.detail: SchemaTree.tsx:93-130 maps all schemas×tables into DOM; each row mounts 1-2 lucide SVGs and rebuilds a tooltip template string. At the stated 500-table/50-schema scale a keystroke re-render will blow the 16ms budget; at 5k tables (partitioned/multi-tenant DBs) mount alone janks. Fix: flatten to a row list + @tanstack/react-virtual (already a dependency for the grid), React.memo rows, precompute lowercase names once per snapshot.

gaps.title: DbSwitcher lies on error: query failure renders 'No databases'
gaps.detail: DbSwitcher.tsx:43-44 catch → setDbs([]) which line 93 renders as 'No databases' — indistinguishable from a real empty result (violates 'never lies'). Keep the error, render it with a retry; only show 'No databases' for a genuine empty list.

gaps.title: Table context menu missing the density that defines a mature client [known]
gaps.detail: SchemaTree.tsx:59-82 has 6 items. Missing: Copy DDL (needs get_ddl backend), View source for views/matviews, Copy column list (comma-joined), Copy INSERT/UPDATE template, Copy count query, Count rows (live), Open in new tab, Export…, Truncate/Drop behind DangerModal, Refresh matview for kind='m'. [known] ROADMAP v0.5 menu epic covers most — Copy column list / count-rows / refresh-matview are not in it and should be added.

gaps.title: Filter matches table name only — no schema, qualified, or column matching; collapsed schemas hide matches
gaps.detail: SchemaTree.tsx:34 tests t.name only: typing 'auth.users' or a schema name yields nothing; no ranking so prefix/exact matches drown in subsequence noise at 500 tables. Also line 94: open = openSchemas[schema] ?? !!filter — an explicitly-collapsed schema stays closed during filtering, so matches show a count but hidden rows. Fix: match against `${schema}.${name}`, rank exact>prefix>subsequence, and let an active filter force-expand.

gaps.title: Filter/expand state leaks across profile switches
gaps.detail: SchemaTree keeps useState filter+openSchemas but App.tsx:36 and the component aren't keyed by profileId — switch connections and profile A's filter still applies to profile B, making the tree mysteriously empty/filtered. Add key={profileId} at the render site or reset state in an effect on profileId change.

gaps.title: Functions, sequences, enums, extensions, triggers invisible in the sidebar
gaps.detail: snapshot.functions is fetched (introspect.rs:121) but never rendered anywhere in the tree; sequences aren't introspected at all (relkind 'S' excluded at introspect.rs:94); enums are claimed by ARCHITECTURE.md but absent [known]; extensions never queried. A PG client that can't show functions/sequences loses to every competitor. Add collapsible per-schema sections (Tables/Views/Functions/Sequences/Enums) with lazy render.

gaps.title: No visual distinction for matview vs view, foreign, partitioned; partitions flood the tree
gaps.detail: SchemaTree.tsx:120-124 collapses kinds to two icons: 'm' shares Eye with 'v'; 'f' and 'p' render as plain tables. Declarative partitions (relispartition) each appear as an independent table — a daily-partitioned table adds 365 rows/year. Introspect relispartition + parent oid, nest partitions under the parent (collapsed by default), and give m/f/p distinct glyphs/badges.

gaps.title: No table metadata: row estimates, sizes, comments [partially known]
gaps.detail: TABLES_SQL (introspect.rs:68) could add reltuples + pg_total_relation_size for near-zero cost [known ROADMAP v0.4] shown as a right-aligned muted badge; pg_description comments (obj_description) are in NO plan and are table-stakes for shared DBs — show as tooltip + in Structure tab.

gaps.title: No favorites/pinning or recents in the tree
gaps.detail: At 50 schemas/500 tables you re-scroll to the same 5 tables all day. Add per-profile pinned tables (appdb or localStorage) rendered in a 'Pinned' section above schemas + 'Pin/Unpin' context-menu item; optionally an automatic 'Recent' section from browse history. ROADMAP descopes connection favorites, but table pins are a different, high-value feature.

gaps.title: Currently open table is not highlighted in the tree
gaps.detail: sidebar-tree.css:48 .tree-table has hover but no .active state and SchemaTree never compares against the active tab's table. Orientation loss all day. Read activeTab from useTabs (kind==='table') and mark the matching row + auto-scrollIntoView.

gaps.title: No sidebar refresh affordance or staleness indicator
gaps.detail: Refresh exists only as ⌘R and a buried per-table context item (SchemaTree.tsx:73-80). DDL run by migrations/colleagues on other connections leaves a silently stale tree. Add a refresh icon-button + 'refreshed Xm ago' in the tree header; consider re-introspect on window focus after N minutes.

gaps.title: DbSwitcher: no filter, no keyboard nav, Esc doesn't close [partially known]
gaps.detail: DbSwitcher.tsx:89-107 is plain buttons: at 50+ databases there's no type-ahead/filter, no arrow-key selection, Esc is unhandled (not in the overlay stack — [known] ROADMAP step-2 followup), and the current db isn't scrolled into view. Fold into AnchoredOverlay + reuse the ContextMenu keyboard pattern + add a filter input for >10 dbs.

gaps.title: Saved queries unusable past ~20: no search, folders, or sort [known]
gaps.detail: SavedQueries.tsx:81-144 renders a flat list inside a 40%-max-height scroll pane (sidebar.css:117-123). At 100+ queries this is the worst surface in the app. [known] ROADMAP has search-box only — folders/tags and sort (name/recent) should be pushed; minimum viable: search + most-recently-used ordering.

gaps.title: Saved queries are global with zero connection affinity
gaps.detail: saved.ts has no profile/db association: a query written against DB A opens (SavedQueries.tsx:27-34) into a tab on whatever connection is active — ⌘Enter then runs it against the wrong database with no warning. Store origin profile/dbname on save; show a small db badge on the row and a mismatch hint when opened elsewhere.

gaps.title: Fixed 248px sidebar, not resizable; long names permanently ellipsized
gaps.detail: v2.css:82-89 hardcodes width:248px. Long table names truncate (sidebar-tree.css:70-74) and the row tooltip shows column count, not the full name. Add a drag handle (pattern exists: inspector resize in App.tsx:76-88) with persisted width; include the full name in the tooltip meanwhile.

gaps.title: looksLikeDdl misfires both ways — wasted refetches and stale schema
gaps.detail: schema.ts:80-81 uses /^\s*(create|alter|...)\b/im: the m flag means ANY line starting with those words — a SELECT containing a string or comment line beginning 'grant' triggers a full re-introspection; meanwhile CALL proc(), DO $$...$$, and SELECT create_hypertable() are missed → silently stale tree. Run the existing statement splitter (execute.rs already lexes strings/comments) or strip literals+comments before the regex, and add CALL/DO to the verb list.

gaps.title: FUNCS introspection pulls all ~3k pg_catalog functions on every refresh [known]
gaps.detail: introspect.rs:121-131 includes pg_catalog and runs pg_get_function_identity_arguments per row on every connect/⌘R/DDL-sniff. [known] ROADMAP v0.3/v0.4: scope to user schemas + ship builtins as a static list for completion.

gaps.title: Stale schema snapshot survives disconnect/profile delete [known]
gaps.detail: schema.ts has no clear/evict path — completion and tree keep serving a deleted or repointed profile's schema; snapshots also accumulate unbounded across profiles (multi-MB each). [known] ROADMAP v0.3. Add useSchema.clear(profileId) called from deleteProfile/invalidateProfile (connections.ts:94,216).

gaps.title: No schema-header context menu or expand/collapse-all
gaps.detail: SchemaTree.tsx:97-106: schema rows only toggle. Right-click should offer Copy schema name, Refresh, Expand/Collapse all, Set as search_path/default, Hide schema (persisted). With 50 schemas, collapse-all is a daily need; Alt-click toggle-others is the mouse-delightful version.

gaps.title: Tables can't expand to show columns inline in the tree
gaps.detail: Column data is already in the snapshot (TableInfo.columns) — TablePlus/DataGrip/Beekeeper all expand a table node to columns (name+type, pk/fk glyphs) with per-column context menu (copy name, copy qualified). Currently only reachable via opening the browser's Structure tab. Add a disclosure level; pairs with virtualization work.

gaps.title: Empty states missing: zero filter matches, zero tables, empty schemas invisible
gaps.detail: SchemaTree.tsx:93: when the filter matches nothing the tree just goes blank (no 'No tables match — clear filter'); a fresh/empty DB shows nothing below the input; snapshot.schemas (schema.ts:49) is never used, so a schema containing only functions/sequences cannot be seen or right-clicked at all.

gaps.title: Saved-query rename silently discards on blur; two inconsistent delete guards; full-SQL tooltip
gaps.detail: SavedQueries.tsx:107 onBlur cancels the draft (platform convention is commit-on-blur; Esc cancels); hover-trash uses 2-click arm (127-141) while the context menu uses DangerModal (56-69) — pick one; title={q.sql} (line 110) puts the entire SQL into a native tooltip (a multi-MB saved query = pathological) — truncate to ~300 chars. No undo toast after delete despite 'cannot be undone'.

gaps.title: DbSwitcher pick() failure is an unhandled rejection
gaps.detail: DbSwitcher.tsx:48-79: try/finally without catch — if ipc.cloneConnection or loadProfiles throws, the rejection escapes void pick(db); busy resets but the user gets no feedback and the popup has already closed. Catch and route into the ConnToast error path.

gaps.title: Introspection ships one giant json_agg cell per statement — memory/parse spike at scale
gaps.detail: introspect.rs:68-98: tables+all columns aggregate into a single text cell; at 10k relations × 30 columns that's a tens-of-MB string through the simple protocol, serde_json parse, then re-serialization over IPC to JS. No concurrent-fetch dedupe either (schema.ts:64 — ⌘R spam runs full duplicate round trips). Paginate/aggregate per schema or stream, and coalesce in-flight fetches per profile.

gaps.title: FK introspection includes pg_temp schemas; PK ignores index validity
gaps.detail: introspect.rs:117-118 filters only pg_catalog/information_schema (TABLES_SQL also excludes pg_toast%/pg_temp% at :96) — temp-table FKs reference relations absent from the tree; :90 uses indisprimary without indisvalid/indisready, so a concurrently-built invalid PK is reported as authoritative (affects editability mapping downstream).

gaps.title: No drag-to-editor, no cmd-click open-in-new-tab, no middle-click
gaps.detail: SchemaTree rows (109-127) support click/dblclick/rightclick only: dragging a table name into the editor to insert the (quoted) identifier, cmd-click to open a browse tab in the background without focusing, are both muscle-memory affordances in DataGrip/TablePlus.

gaps.title: Dead code: ProfileList.tsx renders its own SchemaTree but is imported nowhere
gaps.detail: src/sidebar/ProfileList.tsx (uses SchemaTree at :98) has zero importers — stale pre-v2 sidebar. Delete it or it will rot further (it duplicates delete-arm logic and renders SchemaTree without the sb-tables scroll container).

perf_risks: SchemaTree renders ALL schemas×tables as DOM (no virtualization); each filter keystroke re-renders every row and re-runs fuzzyMatch with fresh toLowerCase() allocations on both needle and hay per table (SchemaTree.tsx:12-40) — precompute lowercase names per snapshot, virtualize, memo rows
Two lucide SVG components + a rebuilt tooltip template string per row per render (SchemaTree.tsx:108-126) — mount cost dominates at 1k+ tables
FUNCS_SQL fetches ~3k pg_catalog functions with pg_get_function_identity_arguments per row on EVERY connect/⌘R/DDL-sniff (introspect.rs:121-131) [known]

Whole-catalog re-introspection triggered by looksLikeDdl false positives (schema.ts:80 'im' flags match any line, even inside string literals) — pointless multi-second round trips after ordinary queries

Single json_agg mega-cell per introspection statement: tens of MB string → serde_json parse → IPC re-serialize at 10k-relation scale; snapshots then retained per profile forever with no eviction (schema.ts:55) — unbounded frontend memory across many connections
No in-flight dedupe/cancel for introspect (schema.ts:64) — ⌘R spam or connect+DDL-sniff overlap runs duplicate full fetches; last write wins
DbSwitcher toggle may create a brand-new PG connection (ensureTabSession) just to list databases (DbSwitcher.tsx:30-42) — popup-open latency on cold tabs
SavedQueries refetches the entire list from appdb after every upsert/remove (saved.ts:33-46) and re-renders all rows — fine at 100, quadratic feel at 1k with autosave-style flows
